context_requirements: Active NAD+ salvage dependence via NAMPT
Functional NAD+ consumption pathways (e.g., PARP, CD38, sirtuins) or high glycolytic flux
Intact stress-response and p53/apoptosis machinery for full transcriptional output
Sufficient intracellular NAD+ depletion to impair ATP production and biosynthetic flux
falsifiers: No consistent induction of DDIT4, SESN1, GADD45A, TRIB3, CHAC1, ATF5, ASCC3, SQSTM1, HERPUD1, DNAJB1, HSPA1A, HSPB1, BAG3, NFIL3, or EGR1 at 6 h or 24 h
No consistent repression of MYC, ID2, CCND1, or cholesterol-synthesis genes at 6 h or 24 h
No late repression of proliferation/cell-cycle genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, CDC25A, CDC25B, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, MCM3, PCNA, UBE2C)
No difference in response between cell lines with high versus low NAMPT dependence
Transcriptional response indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines
